mode: deterministic fixtures and simulated clock; no live calls

scenarios.scenario: Alex asks for the steps, repeats the same request, then restarts the API.
scenarios.expected: 200 with saved demo reply; same reply ID on retry; exactly two ordered messages after restart.

scenarios.scenario: Alex submits [demo:fail] twice with one request ID.
scenarios.expected: Both return 502; one failed user message, no invented assistant; changing content with that ID returns 409.
Application support notice, no assistant reply, zero model calls; not a general distress detector.

scenarios.scenario: Live settings are absent, then the call budget is zero.
scenarios.expected: 503 not_configured, then call_limit; zero actual provider calls.

scenarios.scenario: An existing v1 profile upgrades, selects larger text, and restarts.
scenarios.expected: Standard text default; large choice persists; original message ID preserved; invalid size returns 422.

scenarios.scenario: Alex stops, retries saving, and a stale checkpoint arrives.
scenarios.expected: One stopped row; stale checkpoint cannot revert it; terminal overwrite gives 409; 59,999 ms completion gives 422.

scenarios.scenario: Alex asks about a past session with sharing off, then on.
scenarios.expected: Off retrieves no sessions; on retrieves the stopped record and returns its exact reference ID.

scenarios.scenario: Alex starts another conversation; a separate fictional user has a record.
scenarios.expected: No cross-conversation messages without consent; consent never exposes the other user; direct table query rejected.

scenarios.scenario: Model proposes a write, extra statement, comment, UNION, wildcard, oversized limit or scope bypass.
scenarios.expected: All unsafe plans rejected; [demo:unsafe] returns 422; sessions remain readable.

scenarios.scenario: Model invents a record ID, then times out.
scenarios.expected: invalid_references then 504; zero assistant messages persisted.

scenarios.scenario: Question storage is unavailable before generation.
scenarios.expected: 503; zero provider calls; no claim that the operation was saved.

scenarios.scenario: Alex deletes fictional history during and after a pending request.
scenarios.expected: 429 while busy; confirmed deletion then succeeds, keeps ring preference, and has no foreign-key violations.

scenarios.scenario: all twelve phases complete only after the final exhale, including scheduling delay
scenarios.expected: Twelve phases; final phase is sixth exhale; completion at 60,087 ms including scheduling delay.
scenarios.test: frontend/src/pacer.test.js::all twelve phases complete only after the final exhale, including scheduling delay

scenarios.scenario: support pause freezes remaining cue and explicit resume excludes pause time
scenarios.expected: Pause at 2,350 ms freezes cue; explicit resume excludes 10,000 ms; final active time 2,500 ms.
scenarios.test: frontend/src/pacer.test.js::support pause freezes remaining cue and explicit resume excludes pause time

scenarios.scenario: Stop is terminal; future timer callbacks cannot complete the attempt
scenarios.expected: Stop at 4,050 ms stays stopped after a later 70,000 ms callback.
scenarios.test: frontend/src/pacer.test.js::Stop is terminal; future timer callbacks cannot complete the attempt

scenarios.scenario: large scheduling gaps interrupt instead of catching up or inventing completion
scenarios.expected: A jump from 100 to 65,000 ms produces interrupted, never completed.
scenarios.test: frontend/src/pacer.test.js::large scheduling gaps interrupt instead of catching up or inventing completion

scenarios.scenario: stopping during support counts support time only as excluded
scenarios.expected: Stop during pause records 100 ms active plus 10,000 ms excluded.
scenarios.test: frontend/src/pacer.test.js::stopping during support counts support time only as excluded

scenarios.scenario: fractional pause samples keep active time stable across checkpoints and Stop
scenarios.expected: Fractional pause snapshots all keep active time 900 ms and wall = active + excluded.
scenarios.test: frontend/src/pacer.test.js::fractional pause samples keep active time stable across checkpoints and Stop

cross_case_checks.rule: Retries, failures, and restarts never invent or duplicate a saved assistant reply.
Retrieved history obeys consent and server scope, and unsafe SQL is rejected.
Only the final planned phase completes an exercise; pauses and interruptions do not silently complete it.
